rawContent: @CariniGambarini His speech is in no way "unique". If you make that case, be prepared for #BDS and #BlackLivesMatter and #antifa be declared similarly "unique". We're effectively subcontracting the duties of the justice system to private corporations, which is the definition of fascism.

@ChaosRiot1999 It does. Because if they can do it to a Nazi without due process, they can do it to critics of Israel. Or #BlackLivesMatter.  Or you.

Aside from the fact that Alex Jones sucks, this is really no different from the NFL's arbitrary ban on Colin Kaepernick. Both are wrong.
I'm just glad Alex Jones wasn't shot during a traffic stop. It'd be rough seeing #BlueLivesMatter pop up in progressive bios.
